text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is for you. It's chocolate. 
Thank you so much for always cheering me 
on!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, thanks, Class Rep~. You're so sweet 
to give me some too~.

Valentine's Day. Everyone was handing out 
chocolates to the people they wanted to, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That covers pretty much everything we had 
planned.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To be fair, everyone gets the same 
chocolate. All that's left is yours, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I tried to prepare it, but the size 
is clearly a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Unfairness really isn't good after all. 
I'll switch to the same one as everyone 
else... Yeah.

That afternoon. As I was walking alone 
through Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Top Road-san's Trainer! I'll 
give this to you as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I call it "Oh, My Subjects" chocolate! In 
other words, courtesy chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"From me as well... Here, out of 
courtesy."
choice_data_list: Is Admire Vega going to give me one too?
Will Admire Vega give me one too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Interacting with Top Road-san made 
me... reconsider a few things.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They say it's not totally pointless to 
give something like this to someone who's 
taken care of you.

I received plenty of courtesy chocolates 
from Narita Top Road's classmates.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—!? Even Opera O-chan and Ayabe-san gave 
chocolate to their Trainers...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The size... isn't really that different 
from the ones I handed out... Did I end up 
making similar chocolates...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I have a feeling that's... not a good 
idea. Because—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The degree of care I've received is on 
another level entirely... My feelings of 
gratitude are far, far greater...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've decided...! I don't care if 
it's unfair.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be sure to give you a chocolate 
that's just as big as my feelings for you, 
Trainer."

Afterward, I was called out by Narita Top 
Road—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for always taking care 
of me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Please accept my true, honest 
feelings.
choice_data_list:
That's quite the wrapping... What's 
inside...

That's quite the wrapping... What's 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Inside is... soccer ball-shaped 
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I like soccer. I gave 
everyone mini-sized ones. But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give you a life-sized one, Trainer. 
Something worthy of the sheer scale of my 
feelings."

I took the large parcel in both hands, 
much like holding a watermelon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Did my feelings... reach you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Compared to what you got from Opera-chan 
and Ayabe-san, how is it?
choice_data_list: I-It's hard to compare, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Could you please give that soccer 
ball back?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if that's the case, it's 
fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you know what I think? Equality 
isn't always a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If the depth of our feelings differs, then 
it wouldn't be fair unless the gift 
matches that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So... in other words...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...That is the situation. ...I look 
forward to working with you.

I didn't really understand what was going 
on, but I decided to gratefully accept the 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What's inside is... well, please open it 
and see.
As told, I untie the ribbon...

A refreshing fragrance filled my nostrils. 
This chocolate scent is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"This is special chocolate with a unique 
flavoring. Actually..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a perfumer. So I consulted 
with her, and we made this chocolate 
together to match my image.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When you take a bite, you get hit with a 
citrus aroma first, and while there's 
sweetness, the finish is crisp and 
clean..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm just parroting my mother, but I tried 
to give it that kind of flavor.
choice_data_list: I see. It really does smell lovely.
I see, it really does smell amazing.

text_block_list.text:
The citrus notes lean slightly toward 
lemon, perhaps. The refreshing openness 
reminiscent of a summer sky is simply 
marvelous...

It was a refreshing scent, as if it were 
Narita Top Road's very heart itself.

Looking closely at the box of 
chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I just thought I'd leave a little 
note, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's a little embarrassing. I 
put quite a bit of thought into writing 
it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. But please, don't laugh at me too 
much, okay?

Nodding, you unfold the paper. And the 
words written there were――
For when you're feeling tired

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-I gave it a lot of thought, you know? 
Like longer ones, cuter ones, and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But... I wondered if useful advice might 
be better than just what I personally 
think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And this was what came to mind most 
naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want Trainer-san to feel better! Um, 
just... really, truly better!

Narita Top Road's straightforward and 
clumsy sincerity made me happy, and at the 
same time, brought a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it~, you're smirking a little, 
aren't you?
Thank them with a smile.

It was a Valentine's Day where I truly 
received Narita Top Road's straightforward 
feelings.
